pretreatments.description: Synthetic FW preparation: blending of fruits, vegetables, meat, rice, paste, and dairy products to achieve homogenization.

Thermophilic pretreatment (TPP): Mixing FW and inoculum, incubation at varying temperatures (50, 60, 70, and 80 °C) for varying times (12, 24, 36, and 48 h), followed by reduction to mesophilic (35 ± 2 °C) conditions.
Conventional Thermal Pretreatment (CTP): Heating FW only to 50–80 °C for 1.5 h.
